WHY_I_FIT: As a practicing advocate and IIM Sirmaur MBA graduate, I bring rigorous **courtroom litigation** rigor and structured commercial acumen to the Associate role. Having scored **98.66%** in the nationwide Math Olympiad and cleared both the **Rajasthan Judicial Services Preliminary Examination** in 2024 and **AIBE** in 2021, I combine analytical discipline with legal precision. At **Gandhi & Co.**, I have managed **50+ litigation briefs** across commercial disputes before the **High Court**, drafting **15+ commercial agreements** and **20+ statutory writ petitions** with zero defect compliance. I have represented clients across **100+ court hearings** and led **30+ client consultations** to secure strategic dispute resolutions. Beyond litigation, my entrepreneurial foundation founding **Naraina Jewellers** required modeling a **Rs 25L+** inventory budget, evaluating **5+ manufacturing hubs**, and executing **12+ vendor agreements** under statutory hallmarking compliance. Additionally, my research at **TATA AIG** evaluating **3+ distribution channels**, chairing **40+ delegates** in Model United Nations, and leading **10+ campus initiatives** at IIM Sirmaur reflect my ability to coordinate cross functional stakeholders. I deliver immediate impact across commercial contract drafting, High Court dispute management, and strategic corporate compliance.
